headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals secured a crucial 3-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the Royals' offense. In other news, the Washington Nationals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks in a doubleheader, with CJ Abrams and James Wood making key contributions. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2, with Robbie Ray earning the win.

Several players are dealing with injuries, including Cody Bellinger (New York Yankees) who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Shea Langeliers (Athletics) with a torn meniscus in his right knee and Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins) with a left oblique strain.

The Washington Nationals made a notable trade, acquiring Connelly Early from the Boston Red Sox in exchange for Curtis Mead. The Kansas City Royals also traded Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash. Additionally, the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres for future considerations, while the Houston Astros traded Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for Max Martin.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Detroit Tigers 3-2, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Alex Lange earned the save with a strong 1-inning outing.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Giants Shut Down Angels in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a 9-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, with Robbie Ray earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Close Match**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0 in a low-scoring game. Impact performances came from Parker Messick and Drew Rasmussen on the mound, while Chandler Simpson stood out at the plate.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with several players making an impact on the game. Geraldo Perdomo, Gabriel Moreno, Ketel Marte, and Ryan Waldschmidt led the charge for the Diamondbacks, while James Wood, Dylan Crews, CJ Abrams, Brady House, Jacob Young, and Luis García Jr. contributed to the Nationals' win.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Cody Bellinger on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cody Bellinger, the left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher Connelly Early**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-hander Connelly Early, acquired in a trade with the Boston Red Sox. Early joins the Nationals in exchange for third baseman Curtis Mead.
